title: ever ASPYN|Short Sleeve Pleated Applique A-Line Floor-Length Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with this stunning A-Line floor-length formal dress! Featuring short sleeves and exquisite pleated applique detailing, this gown gracefully flatters the figure while providing a classic silhouette. The soft, flowing fabric cascades beautifully, making it perfect for any formal occasion, from elegant galas to unforgettable weddings. The timeless design ensures you??£¤ll make a memorable entrance, while the intricate embellishments add a touch of glamour. Slip into this enchanting dress and let the night unfold in style!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "no bra" option, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
